Popular Custom Blind Styles

  • Faux Wood Blinds: Ideal for high-humidity areas, these offer the look of real wood without the maintenance.
  • Vertical Blinds: A practical choice for large windows and sliding glass doors, providing excellent light control.
  • Aluminum Blinds: Durable and versatile, these come in various finishes and slat sizes for a sleek, modern appearance.
  • Cellular Shades: Known for energy efficiency, these help insulate your home, keeping it cooler in summer and warmer in winter.
  • Wood Blinds: Offering timeless elegance and warmth, real wood blinds can be customized to match your décor.
  • Roman Shades: These combine the soft elegance of drapes with the convenient operation of shades, including blackout options.
  • Woven Wood Blinds: Crafted from natural materials like bamboo, these add an organic, textural element to your interiors.
  • Top-Down Bottom-Up Shades: Providing flexible light and privacy control, these allow opening from either the top or bottom.
